posts.en:
dsh-nuphus-mcp is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-277bee449f832859d7b0.html
